TaskDescription: [online 1D and 2D cursor control] One longitudinal MI-BCI study release with 39 unique participants. The primary randomized experiment included 31 participants: joint learning (n=15), BCI2000 control (n=8), and tactile control (n=8). A separately recruited EEGNet-control cohort added 8 participants. Trial duration: 5.0s, imagery: 5.0s.
